description:
## Problem
The channel-based `Semaphore` can lose permits if a fiber is cancelled after `acquire` but before `release`. Crystal fiber cancellation bypasses `ensure` blocks, so the permit is consumed but never returned. Over time this drains all permits, causing a deadlock.

The `Fetcher#fetch_single` `ensure` block handles normal exceptions (`@semaphore.release if acquired`), but fiber cancellation is a different mechanism.

## File
- `src/vug/semaphore.cr`
- `src/vug/fetcher.cr` (lines 203-210)

## Fix
- Add a timeout to `acquire` using `select` so fibers don't block indefinitely
- Consider a health-check mechanism or periodic permit audit
- At minimum, document the limitation clearly

## Acceptance
- Semaphore does not deadlock under fiber cancellation scenarios
- Acquire has a configurable timeout
- Existing tests pass
title: Fix Semaphore permit leak on fiber cancellation
